name: Memory
summary: The list after a delete. A toast confirms what happened, the group it came from is two rows shorter, and the memory is gone from everywhere it appeared.

looseEnds.title: The toast carries an Undo that is switched off
looseEnds.detail: The Toast component has an Action slot holding “Undo”. This frame hides it, so the only control is the dismiss. Delete is otherwise a one-way door with a dialog as its only gate.
looseEnds.ask: Is Undo coming, or is the dialog the whole protection? If it is coming, how long does it stay?

looseEnds.title: The toast sits over the summary card
looseEnds.detail: It lands at y=60, which on a scrolled list covers the card rather than the rows the delete changed. Nothing says whether the list scrolls to the affected group first.
looseEnds.ask: Does the list move to show what changed, or does the toast do all the telling?

looseEnds.title: The summary card is headed “What you’ve told me” here
looseEnds.detail: Every other Memory frame heads it “What you’ve told PC Chat™”, and uses the brand mark rather than a placed image for the icon.
